notes.drawing: arrow-counter-clockwise's circle and arrowhead with "10" inside, 64 tall: the "1" as list-numbers draws it, the "0" an ellipse 40 wide, from y 106 to 166. The pair sits off centre, 4 units to the right of the circle's centre, so the "1"'s flag keeps 16 units from the arrowhead's arm and the "0" keeps 16 from the circle.
notes.bold: The numerals are 56 tall instead of 60 and sit 4 lower, the "0" is 36 wide instead of 40 and 4 units further from the "1", and the flag 12 wide: at full size the thicker strokes touched the arrowhead and closed the gap between the two numerals.
notes.fill: As arrow-counter-clockwise-fill: the arrowhead becomes a solid triangle; the numerals stay lines so they stay legible.
